meta.title: Iran Carpet World — Persian rugs from the workshops of Iran
meta.description: Hand-knotted Persian rugs from verified sellers in Iran, with the full delivered price shown before you ask.

brand.name: Iran Carpet World
brand.tagline: From Iran’s heritage to homes around the world.

home.heroTitle: Rugs knotted in Iran, measured for your floor.
home.heroBody: Every rug is listed by the shop that sells it and checked by our team before it appears here. You see its true size, materials and the full delivered price to your country.
home.trust1Body: Sellers in Iran list each rug with photos, size and materials.
home.trust2Body: Our team reviews every listing. Origin, age and materials are confirmed by the seller, never guessed from a photo.
home.trust3Body: Shipping, insurance, customs duty and import VAT are listed separately, so the total holds no surprises.
home.sellerBody: Send photos to our Telegram bot and answer a few questions in Persian. We translate your listing into English and German.
